summary: Lisata Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment and waiver to its March 6, 2026 merger agreement with Kuva Labs Inc. (Parent) and Kuva Acquisition Corp. (Purchaser). The amendment extends the deadline for Purchaser to commence a tender offer for all outstanding Lisata common stock from April 13, 2026 to May 29, 2026. Parent agreed to pay up to $1.1 million of Lisata's expenses until the offer starts. Lisata waived claims related to the delayed commencement, subject to Parent's payment and performance. This is a tender offer extension. Watch for the offer launch by May 29; risk-arb spreads may widen if delays persist.
